title: Authenticated state
text: Before daemon start, the runner checks identities with automatic sites and signs expired first-party test accounts in through unrecorded Playwright using machine-local secret files. Human sign-in stays human. The runner can select the recorded account in Google's chooser; a missing account or remaining Google sign-in page ends as browser_sign_in_setup and names browser authorize. sign_in.authenticated becomes true only after a case step observes the app's signed-in page; automatic setup alone is not that evidence.
